Caller: FUN_00462F7C.

name: Battle_UpdateEnemySleepMask

evidence: String literals s_sleep_enemy_check and s_EnemyBaseParam; func_0028B820/func_0028B70C/func_0028B71C resolve the flag, func_0063DCA4 fetches the enemy record; writes bit fields at arg2+i+0x54 and the special first-slot handling via group->f_5A/f_54.

name: Font_GetGlyphCell

name: Math_Obb_ContainsPoint

name: maybe_Camera_ComputeAnchorPoint

name: Gfx_Scene_FindFirstEntryInRect

summary: Destructor of a UI object that owns a 16-element array of 0xA0-byte sub-objects: installs the two-part vtable, destroys the array and chains to the UI base destructor.
evidence: Sets object->f_4C and the vtable to g_006C2E70 / +0xA8, func_00100BE0(object+0x58, dtor, 0xA0, 0x10) (std_destroy_range, N_037), then func_001A6768 + func_0010F6CC.

name: Ui_Object_DtorWithArray6
summary: Same destructor shape for an object owning a 6-element array of 0xA0-byte sub-objects.
evidence: Identical to 0x006C2E34 with element count 6 and vtables g_006C2EE0.

name: Ui_TextFormat_ReleaseSlot
summary: Releases the scratch text buffer of one of the 0x108-byte formatted-string slots and re-points its cursor at the fresh buffer at +0xC.
evidence: Indexes g_006D3ED8 by slot*0x108, calls func_00707C1C(buffer+8) and rewrites slot+4 = slot+0xC; ~20 message-argument helpers call it after formatting.

name: Event_RunTriggerCommandCallbacks
signature: int Event_RunTriggerCommandCallbacks(EventContext* ctx, unsigned commandFilter, unsigned unusedC, unsigned char* out)
summary: Runs the script callback for every trigger command whose type matches the filter: iterates the 0x18-byte command table, creates a VM for the entry's script and invokes it, returning whether the result was handled.
evidence: Loops ctx->f_98..f_9C by 0x18, tests byte +0 and type byte +0xC against arg2 (0xFF = any), sets ctx->f_6C, builds a VM with func_00579B64, applies func_006BC724, calls func_006BB984(...,0xFFFFFFFE,...) and copies the result through func_006F4438; callers are the Event_OnFieldEnd/OnCutSceneEnd/FireTrgEvent handlers.

name: Field_SpriteActor_SetupSpriteA
summary: Creates the sprite model and animation instance for a field sprite actor from a sprite table record: resolves the sprite id, allocates the 0x178-byte model, applies the anim template, links it to the actor and sets its size.
evidence: func_0066A7B8 + func_0062C388/func_0062C3B0 resolve the sprite entry, Mem_AllocAligned(0x178), func_002D1F28 builds the anim instance, func_002D1304 (ApplyTemplate), func_005E7650 links it, func_005F3500 sets model+anim ids. Callers are the sprite-attach and message-sprite-pane helpers.

name: Field_SpriteActor_SetupSpriteB
summary: Identical setup to Field_SpriteActor_SetupSpriteA but builds the anim instance from the descriptor whose name pointer is the PTR_s_sprite literal.
evidence: Same call sequence as 0x006D4B34; the only difference is the descriptor/name used for func_002D1F28 (PTR_s_sprite_006D4ED0).

name: Ui_MessageVoice_UpdateLine0
summary: Per-frame update of the voice/typing stream for message line 0: starts the stream on first use (with the line's character voice) and advances it by the frame delta, playing the completion SE once.
evidence: func_0064DE54/func_0064DE78 select the line-0 character voice, func_002CFCC0 creates the stream, func_0041AD28 advances it, func_00328138 plays g_006D4FE4 on completion. The eight sibling functions differ only in line index 0..4 and whether they release the voice handle.

name: Ui_MessageVoice_FinishLine0
summary: Variant of the line-0 message voice update that additionally stops and clears the voice handle when the line completes.
evidence: Same as 0x006D4EDC plus Sound_SetVoiceGainByHandle (N_042) on message->f_608, writes 0xFFFF into g_006D5120[message] and clears f_608.

name: Ui_MessageVoice_UpdateLine1
summary: Line-1 variant of the message voice update; unlike line 0 it measures the first three text runs to decide whether the line needs a 'long' voice stream.
evidence: func_0064DE54/func_0064DE78 with index 1, func_0046C438 (Text_MeasureGlyphRun, N_063) over lines 0..2, func_002CFCC0(1, hasLongLine, ...).

name: Ui_MessageVoice_FinishLine1
summary: Line-1 voice update with voice-handle release on completion.
evidence: Same as 0x006D5128 plus the Sound_SetVoiceGainByHandle/0xFFFF cleanup on message->f_608.

name: Ui_MessageVoice_UpdateLine2
summary: Line-2 variant of the message voice update.
evidence: func_0064DE54/func_0064DE78 with index 2 and message+0x4E as the voice selector; func_0046C438 over lines 0..2; func_002CFCC0(2, ...).

name: Ui_MessageVoice_FinishLine2
summary: Line-2 voice update with voice-handle release on completion.
evidence: Same as 0x006D546C plus the handle cleanup writing 0xFFFF into g_006D57A8[message].

name: Ui_MessageVoice_UpdateLine3
summary: Line-3 variant of the message voice update.
evidence: func_0064DE54/func_0064DE78 with index 3 and message+0x4F; func_0046C438 over lines 0..2; func_002CFCC0(3, ...).

name: Ui_MessageVoice_FinishLine3
summary: Line-3 voice update with voice-handle release on completion.
evidence: Same as 0x006D57B0 plus the handle cleanup writing 0xFFFF into g_006D5AEC[message].

name: Ui_MessageVoice_FinishLine4
summary: Line-4 voice update with voice-handle release on completion (there is no plain-update counterpart for this line).
evidence: func_0064DE54/func_0064DE78 with index 4 and message+0x50, func_0046C438 over lines 0..2, func_002CFCC0(4, ...), then the handle cleanup writing 0xFFFF into g_006D5CA8[message].

name: Field_SpriteMarker_Create
summary: Creates a 2D sprite marker/icon from a marker record: resolves the sprite and its glyph set, builds the base mesh, attaches the glyph sprite plus up to four extra animation children and stores the record pointers for later updates.
evidence: Stores record fields (f_30..f_3C), func_00319848 (CreateFromTable), func_0063E54C/func_0063FBF4 (sprite + glyph set), func_0031A394 (CreateSpriteMesh), func_005C8738/func_005CCF88 (glyph sprites), four func_00335A6C children with frame ids 0x40/1/0x400/0x800. Callers are the field scene-object spawn helpers.

name: Field_SpriteMarker_CreateRandomVariant
summary: Same marker creation as Field_SpriteMarker_Create but first picks one sprite variant at random from the weighted variant table, so decorative markers vary between instances.
evidence: Extra prologue walks the variant table (record pointer + count), sums weights and uses Math_RandRangeInt(0, total) to select; the rest is identical to 0x006D6114.

name: Sound_VoiceSlotAlloc
summary: Allocates one of the object's 0x14-byte voice slots for the given time value, marks it in the slot bitmask and returns the slot through the caller's pointer arithmetic (the routine itself only fills the entry).
evidence: Computes index = (time - slots->f_8)*g_006D6D70 >> 0x24, bounds it against slots->f_10, calls func_0011AE20(slot, index*5, count, ...) and clears the bit in the mask at slots->f_C. Callers are Sound_PlaySeById and FUN_001ECADC, i.e. the voice/SFX dispatch path.

name: Ui_CommandQueue_Advance
summary: Pops and executes one pending UI command: releases the object at the top of the stack, decrements the depth, calls the queued function pointer and resumes the next queued object.
evidence: Classic command-stack walk: queue[0xF] depth, blocks of 3 ints, func_0010EBD8 (release) on the top object, invokes queue[1] (or an entry of the vtable array when bit 1 of queue[2] is set), then func_001A5F9C(next, 1) (Ui_Object_BroadcastToChildren).

name: Ui_CommandQueue_AdvanceAlt
summary: Duplicate of Ui_CommandQueue_Advance for the Sakusen-window command queue.
evidence: Instruction-identical to 0x006D7200; 21 call sites are all Ui_SakusenWindow_* helpers.

name: Ui_CommandQueue_FindEntry
signature: int Ui_CommandQueue_FindEntry(int* queue, int commandId, unsigned flags)
summary: Advances the command queue until it finds the entry whose command id matches, then compares its flag word against the requested flags.
evidence: Loops Ui_CommandQueue_AdvanceAlt, then indexes queue + queue[0xF]*3 and compares entry[1] with arg2 and entry[2] with arg3, with a special case for command 0 plus flag bit 0. Callers are the Sakusen-window pane/close commands.

name: Field_SceneObject_ReleaseResourceHandles
summary: Releases every packed resource handle held by a field scene object: about 120 (offset, handle) pairs are zeroed and returned to the resource manager.
evidence: Sequence of `object->f_XXX = 0; Pack_ReleaseHandleEntry(&object->f_XXX)` for offsets 0x2B4..0x780, 0x5CC..0x608, 0x6A4..0x780, 0x41C..0x5C0; called from the object's destructor path (FUN_002D6C54).

name: Ui_Object_DtorThunk2
summary: Minimal destructor thunk that calls the UI base destructor; the truncated control flow is a tail call into the deleting destructor.
evidence: Only call is func_001A6768 (Ui_Object_DtorBase, N_040) followed by Ghidra's 'bad instruction' truncation, which is the usual pattern for a jumptable/tail-call thunk.
